## AgentBridge v0.1.4

This release improves manual host installation and makes remote Web Console access easier to enable.

### Added

- Manual installation now checks inbound TCP 6160 after Deployment Kit installation. It opens the port for any source when needed, skips existing allow rules, and reports whether AgentBridge can reach the host. Supported guest firewall managers include Windows Defender Firewall, firewalld, ufw, and iptables.
- Remote Web Console access can use HTTP without TLS certificates. Supplying both `--tls-cert` and `--tls-key` enables HTTPS; remote access still requires `--admin-token-file`.
- The remote Web Console prompts for the admin token and keeps it in browser memory for the current page session.

### Security

- Remote management API routes now require the admin bearer token. The UI warns when remote access uses HTTP because the token and management traffic are unencrypted; use HTTP only on a trusted LAN or VPN.
